_expect: ACCEPT: '%EF%BC%8A' (a folder literally named with a full-width asterisk) and '%20' (a space) are opaque canonical escapes; nothing decodes them, so they match only themselves and cannot read or act as a wildcard (D40). The trailing '*.pdf' is an embedded glob under the review gate, as documented

provides.description: Extract typed fields from PDF/DOCX contracts

notes: Accuracy degrades on scanned documents below 200 dpi.
